selected_evidence.summary: Proves valid shell syntax, executable permissions, root ownership, and unchanged checksum after restart.
Proves exactly one 02:15 daily cron entry and an active, boot-enabled scheduler before and after restart.
Proves successful execution, requested log creation, persistence through restart, and line count increasing from one to two via append redirection.
Captures the healthy baseline, acknowledged delayed native reboot, changed boot ID, and recovered scheduler, crontab, executable, retained data, and post-restart execution.
